title: comfy knowledge *
description: Output shape for the knowledge-bundle commands (status, resolve, pick). All subcommands share this schema; each field is optional because the payload varies per subcommand.

stale.description: True when served from an expired cache after a failed fetch.

schema_version.description: Bundle schema version the loader accepts (status).

as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp: file mtime (status) or the capability's as_of, null when the capability has none (pick).

path.description: File the bundle bytes were read from (status).

url.description: URL a fetch uses: COMFY_KNOWLEDGE_URL, else knowledge.json under the cloud base URL; userinfo, query and fragment removed (status).

cache_path.description: Where a fetched bundle is cached (status).

query.description: The alias or id as given (resolve), or the capability text that matched nothing, clipped (pick).

zero_hit.description: True when the capability text matched nothing curated (pick). A miss is an answer, so the envelope stays ok.

nudge.description: One line naming the miss and pointing at the ids the bundle does cover (pick, zero_hit=true).

model.description: The full model row as shipped in the bundle (resolve).

bundle_version.description: Bundle version the answer came from (resolve, pick).

capabilities.description: Every capability in the bundle, id-sorted (pick with no argument).

description.description: Capability description, null when the capability has none (pick).

status.description: Copied from the pick's model row when that row exists.

superseded_by.description: Copied from the pick's model row when that row exists.

fits.description: The model row's fits block (vram_gb per variant, a credit rate, max_refs, source), present only when the row carries one.
